text: {"bull":["Sales grew from ₹5,054 cr in Mar 2024 to ₹6,813 cr in Mar 2026, a 35% increase over two years.","Operating profit rose from ₹779 cr in Mar 2024 to ₹1,785 cr in Mar 2026, more than doubling.","Net profit surged from ₹162 cr in Mar 2024 to ₹890 cr in Mar 2026, a 456% jump.","Operating profit margin climbed from 15.4% in Mar 2024 to 26.2% in Mar 2026, reflecting improved efficiency."],"bear":["Operating profit margin dropped from 24% in Mar 2025 to 24% in Jun 2025, showing stagnation before rising again.","Net profit fell from ₹233 cr in Mar 2025 to ₹162 cr in Jun 2025, a 30% decline before recovering.","Debt-to-EBITDA increased from 1.25 in Q4 FY26 to 1.28 in Q1 FY27, indicating higher leverage.","R&D spend as % of revenue rose from 4.1% in FY26 to 5.8% in Q1 FY27, a 70% increase that may pressure margins." ]}
